tower_dictate.name: Dictate
tower_dictate.description: Tap to start or stop, or hold to talk. The tower cleans up the text before it's pasted.

tower_raw.name: Dictate (raw)
tower_raw.description: Same as Dictate, but pastes the transcript without cleanup.

settings.title: Tower dictation
settings.description: The mic on the tower server records; this computer sends hotkeys and pastes the text.

backend.title: Dictation backend
backend.description: Tower: the tower's mic and models do the work. Local: Handy's own microphone and models.
backend.localNote: Local mode works like stock Handy. Switch back to Tower to use the tower's mic.

connection.urlDescription: The dictation service on the tower, e.g. http://192.168.1.182:8790.
connection.tokenDescription: DICTATION_TOKEN from the tower. Stored in this app's settings file.
connection.health: Tower answered. Speech model: {{asr}}, mic: {{mic}}, cleanup model: {{llm}}.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: F14/F15 without modifiers: Deskflow swaps alt and super on the Mac, so modifier combos are unreliable.

setup.title: Tower dictation
setup.intro: Handy will use the mic on the tower server, so there is no model to download and no microphone to allow here. Enter the tower's address and token to start.
setup.accessibilityNeeded: Handy needs Accessibility to paste the text. Grant it again after every update of this unsigned app.

overlay.held: Held: press hotkey to paste, Esc to discard

messages.no_token: Set the tower token in Settings
